default.notes: Apply online at visit.doi.gov.bt (directly or through a licensed Bhutanese tour operator) — US$40 visa fee plus the Sustainable Development Fee of US$100 per person per night. The visa is issued for your exact travel dates before arrival.

BT.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Bhutanese citizens.

IN.notes: No visa needed, but Indian nationals must hold an entry permit — issued online at visit.doi.gov.bt or on arrival at Paro airport and the Phuentsholing land border (passport or voter ID) — and pay the Sustainable Development Fee of ₹1,200 per night.

BD.notes: Visa issued free of charge on arrival for Bangladeshi citizens; the Sustainable Development Fee applies — confirm the current rate for your category before travel.

MV.notes: Visa issued free of charge on arrival for Maldivian citizens; the Sustainable Development Fee applies — confirm the current rate for your category before travel.
